concept: Placement groups: cluster for lowest-latency HPC
tests: Choosing an EC2 placement strategy for tightly coupled HPC with maximum throughput and minimum latency.
expected: Cluster placement group — instances close together in one AZ, low latency and high throughput. Triggers: "tightly coupled HPC", "lowest latency", "highest network throughput".
why_not: Spread — maximum isolation; partition — for large distributed systems (Hadoop, Cassandra); multiple AZs increase latency.
